senses.gloss: f. (נמא, cmp. נְמָיָה = נְבָיָיה, also meanings of נִיב, נִיבָא) [hanging over,]

units: <cite ref="Beitzah 14b:14">Bets. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תכרך נ׳ וכ׳</he> lest a fringe (shred of the garment used as mattress) wind itself around his body; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:1:14">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Niddah 67a:21">Nidd. 67ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>נ׳ אחת</he> one single thread; Y. Sabb. VII, 7ᵈ top <cite ref="N00856"><he>נמא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:4">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>קשר חבל בחבל ונ׳ בנ׳</he> (Ar. <he>ניניא</he>) he tied rope to rope, string to string.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:4">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ אחת היתה לו בלבו</he> he had one bristle on his chest; Yalk. ib. 150.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:22">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, end <he>קשר בה נ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>ניניא</he>) he tied a string to it …, and hanged himself.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 1:2">Tosef. Sot. I, 2</cite> <he>כדי שיקשור הגרדי נ׳</he> as much time as the weaver needs to knot a fringe; Y. ib. I, 16ᶜ bot.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:18">B. Bath. 16ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="O01303"><he>סערה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Job 38:1">Job XXXVIII, 1</cite>) <he>וכל נ׳ ונ׳ וכ׳</he> for each hair (of the eye-brow) &c., v. <cite ref="C00412"><he>גּוּמָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:9">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מלא נ׳</he> a thread’s (or hair’s) breadth.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:13">Erub. X, 13</cite> <he>קושרין נ׳ במקדש</he> they were permitted to knot a broken string of a musical instrument in the Temple; <cite ref="Eruvin 102b:15">ib. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>נִימַת כינור</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִימִין</he>. B. Bath. l. c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 8:5">Shek. VIII, 5</cite> ed. (Ms. M. <he>נִירִין</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Yoma 38b:2">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> <he>בין הנ׳</he> on the division line between the two parts of the mustache.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 12b:3">Ab. Zar. 12ᵇ</cite>. [<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:12">Ib. 10ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00372"><he>נוֹמִי</he></cite>.].
